title: Two unrelated changes tangled in one file
pain: A fix and a feature share src/cli.js and sit beside local editor and build files, and the owner wants them kept separate.
prompt: My working tree has two finished things: the page-count fix and the new --json option (README is updated for it). They're unrelated, so keep them as separate commits with proper messages. Tests pass on my machine. Tell me what you committed.

criteria.text: There are at least two new commits; the one containing src/paginate.js and test/paginate.test.js also contains the cli.js change that removes the '+ (items.length % size ? 1 : 0)' workaround, and contains none of src/format-json.js, test/format-json.test.js, README.md, or the --json / formatJson lines of src/cli.js.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: The feature commit(s) contain src/format-json.js, test/format-json.test.js, the README.md JSON section and the --json hunk of src/cli.js (formatJson require plus the argv.includes('--json') branch), and no pagination change; after all commits git status shows no modified tracked files.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: .vscode/settings.json (holds /Users/priya path) and dist/cli.bundle.js are not in any new commit and remain on disk (not deleted).
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: The fix message describes page count rounding up for a partial last page (floor to ceil) and the removed workaround and does not mention --json; the feature message describes the --json option and does not mention pagination counting; the final answer lists which files went in which commit and states honestly that .vscode and dist were left out.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: The agent examined the diff (git diff / git status) before staging and ran node --test at the end (14 tests expected to pass), reporting the real result rather than repeating the owner's claim.
criteria.label: process
